verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents fine-grained role-based access control, including restricting who can modify production environments, which covers the roles-and-permissions core of the story. However, nothing in the evidence describes scoped API tokens. The only API credential mentioned is a public, non-secret Environment Key, and access scoping is shown at the environment level rather than per flag. Missing for 10: scoped/least-privilege API tokens for the Admin API, per-flag permission granularity, detailed role and permission model documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can restrict who can change which flags with roles, permissions, and scoped API tokens

citations.quote: Role-based access control (RBAC) provides fine-grained access management of Flagsmith resources.
Only allow certain users to modify your production environments.
Using RBAC, you can ensure users only have the access they need within your Flagsmith organisation.
